title: Which clock the Japanese regiment's report keeps
basis: Japanese army records are usually read as Tokyo time. The report's sunrise falls within two minutes of the sun's at UTC+8 and an hour from Tokyo time's, and its 18:40 dusk only fits local time; the times the two sides both record (the east gate at about 14:00, the west gate at 17:00) agree on it.

records.says: 日出 午前六時二十分 日没 午後五時五十分
records.label: the report's table for 16 March (sunrise 06:20, sunset 17:50); at Tengxian the sun rose at about 06:23 UTC+8, 07:23 Tokyo time

records.says: 1840趁薄暮一气突入
records.label: the 3rd Battalion's dusk assault, 16 March; sunset at 18:19 UTC+8

title: When the line at 界河 broke
reading: The village entered on the 14th; the line round it given up at 13:00 on the 15th
basis: The 63rd's record is of the village; the Chinese one of the whole line from 界河 to 龍山, which Seya's order of 10:30 on the 15th, issued at 界河, shows was still held east of it.

records.says: 1810进入界河
records.label: the 63rd Regiment, 14 March

records.says: 13时，界河正面阵地被日军突破
records.label: 15 March

title: Which way the Japanese swung round the city
reading: By 東郭 and 王廟, east and south-east of the city
basis: The Japanese orders and the 10th Regiment's report give the route; 龍陽店 appears in no Japanese record and may have been a flank screen.

records.says: 前衛ハ正午龍山店附近出発 龍山店―東郭 王廟道ニ沿フ地区ヲ王廟ニ向ヒ前進スヘシ
records.label: 瀬支作命第九号 (the advance guard leaves 龍山店 at noon along the 龍山店–東郭–王廟 road)

records.says: 以万余兵力由龙山东侧向滕县城迂回…下午5时许，其先头部队已达滕县城东北的龙阳店、冯河一带
records.label: 《滕县志》 (over ten thousand round the east of 龍山; by 17:00 the van was at 龍陽店 and 馮河, north-east of the city)

title: What the heavy battalion fired
reading: Twelve Type 4 15 cm howitzers, range 8.8 km
basis: Three of the four records, Jiang's own table among them, give 15 cm; the range is the Type 4's with its charge increased, as Jiang gives it.

records.says: 野战重炮兵第二联队一大队(4年式15榴12门)
野戦重砲兵第二聯隊の第Ⅰ大隊（91式105mm榴弾砲12門）も到着し、東関の寨門に向け試射開始
records.label: Jiang's narrative of 16 March

records.says: 4年式15糎榴弾砲 1 battalion × 12
records.label: Jiang's own table of the guns

records.says: 野战重炮兵第2联队第1大队（150毫米榴弹炮12门）

title: Which Type 38 field gun the field battalion had, and its reach
reading: The improved Type 38, drawn to its maximum range of 11,600 m
basis: The same battalion is recorded with the improved gun at Taierzhuang; the range fan shows the furthest a shell could reach, not the effective range.

records.says: 野砲兵第十聯隊第一大隊の改造38式野砲（7.5糎）8門

records.says: 38式野砲：…有効射撃距離約8,000ｍ

basis: The report's narrative of the day; its plan had set breaching for 08:00.

07:30 ranging; about 1 hour of harassing fire; 09:00 wall-breaching fire begins
東門附近ノ如キハ僅カ五十發ニシテ殆ト完成ス

title: Where the armoured train was taken
basis: 王家樓 is not located; 南沙河 is the station south of the city on the 63rd's line of advance.

records.says: 飛行機ヨリノ通報ニ依レハ歩六三ハ午後十二時三十分王家樓ニ達シ敵装甲列車一、機関車一輛ヲ鹵獲シアリ

title: Whether any Chinese 15 cm howitzer fired at Tengxian
reading: None: the defenders had mortars, the armoured train and, south of the city, a few mountain guns
basis: No record puts the 15 cm battalion with the division Tang Enbo sent toward Tengxian; its first recorded fire is at Taierzhuang.

records.says: 拥有7门炮的一营最先被配给汤恩伯第20军团，1938年3月中旬驰援第五战区。

title: What happened at the east suburb on 16 March
reading: The gate breached by 14:00; the 3rd Company holds its corner of the suburb from 14:15, and the defenders the rest into the night
basis: The Japanese report records the lodgement and no ejection; the Chinese counter-attack may have recovered ground within the suburb.

records.says: 3月16日10时半，日军炮火猛烈轰击东关，东关城墙被炸开了一二十米的缺口
下午5时，日军发动第六次攻势，突入城内40余人
下午6时后，严营长组织2个连发起反击，把突入的日军消灭
第二回目の集中砲撃により、城（寨）門は完全に破壊され

records.says: 敵ノ抵抗頗ル執拗ニシテ著シク進展セス

title: When the Japanese held the south wall

title: How and when Wang Mingzhang was killed
reading: About 17:30, in the moat outside the west gate, shot from the gate tower with his staff
basis: Most accounts put it in the west suburb after the west gate fell, at about 17:00 on both sides' records, and before dark; the Japanese found his chief of staff's body outside the west gate. Jiang's estimate of 17:30.

records.says: 从城墙西北角缒城后奔西关外火车站，在西关电灯厂附近壕沟内被西城门楼上的日军发现遭密集扫射
records.label: let down from the north-west corner, making for the station, machine-gunned from the west gate tower in a ditch near the power plant

records.says: 王铭章是在3月17日下午5时左右牺牲的
王铭章率部拼死抵抗，不幸身中数弹，壮烈殉国
records.label: at 15:00

records.says: 在城中心十字街口指揮作戰時，不幸中彈殉職
